github.description: DLR (Decoupled Logic Representation) + Three-Level Semantic Modeling (TSM) — a data-source-level semantic-layer paradigm, its TypeScript service (LanceDB + Neo4j), the dsh integration, and two benchmark scenarios: BIRD mini-dev (500/500) and Cloud-OpsBench (JRA 752/754).

install.reason: Repository does not expose an installable DSH bundle.

presentation.description: DLR (Decoupled Logic Representation) is an original data-source-level semantic modeling paradigm: a two-layer model (LE logical entities / PE physical views) plus two mechanisms (ARCS projection anchoring, PAS semantic routing). It decouples the logical concept layer from the phy
